int d, cur, a[N];
long long n;

struct matrix {
    long long f[D][D];

    matrix() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                f[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    matrix operator*(const matrix& oth) const {
        matrix ans;
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {

                    ans.f[i][j] = (ans.f[i][j] + f[i][k] * oth.f[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
} bas[N];

    u = (u + d) % d;
    matrix ans;
    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
        ans.f[i][(i + u) % d] = 1;
    }
    ans.f[d][d] = 1;
    return ans;
}

    for (int i = 1; i < d; i++) {
        bas[0].f[i][i] = 1;
    }
    bas[0].f[d][0] = 1;

        }
    }
    cout << (ans.f[d][d] + MOD) % MOD;
